description: 全景 rubric — establishing shots; scene-layout consistency, composition and motion coherence dominate; per-face drift is weighted down (faces are small) but scene 禁止变化项 are weighted up.

axes.label: 场景一致性 (layout / light direction / palette vs bible)
checks: 大殿布局 matches the locked scene reference (pillars, throne placement)
光源方向不可变 — moonlight enters from the same direction
色调不可变 — cold-blue noir palette preserved

axes.label: 构图 / 景别 (slideshow_risk guard)
checks: true 全景 scale — subject reads small in frame, environment dominant
not a static slideshow frame: the camera move (缓慢推进) is evident across frames

axes.label: 运动连贯 (video only)
checks: subject and camera move coherently across the contact-sheet frames
no teleporting / morphing / flicker between slice-centers

axes.label: 轮廓解剖 (silhouette)
checks: silhouette/limbs read correctly even at distance

axes.label: 建场兑现
checks: establishes the dramatic geography the intent promises
final_review: a human director would accept this establishing take

禁止变化项_hook: compare against the scene reference; any 大殿布局/光源方向/色调 change => failure_mode=drift, drift=true
